type_schema.description:
NEAR Account Identifier.

This is a unique, syntactically valid, human-readable account identifier on the NEAR network.

[See the crate-level docs for information about validation.](index.html#account-id-rules)

Also see [Error kind precedence](AccountId#error-kind-precedence).

## Examples

``` use near_account_id::AccountId;

let alice: AccountId = "alice.near".parse().unwrap();

assert!("ƒelicia.near".parse::<AccountId>().is_err()); // (ƒ is not f) ```

functions.name: lift_freeze
functions.doc:
Owner only. Lifts a freeze once the target's latest report is final (Verified or Rejected),
 typically after the target's new code has been classified again. Never while a report is
 Pending or Disputed. Claims are unaffected: they read the report's state, not this flag.
 Vaults lift their cached freeze at their next `refresh_class`.

functions.name: report_drift
functions.doc:
Filed by the attestor's account, signed by its separate signing key over every report field.
 Accepting it freezes the target at once, before the challenge window closes (plan R16).
 Returns the report id.

functions.name: rotate_signing_key
functions.doc: Replace the signing key. Past reports stay valid; they were checked when filed.

functions.name: rule
functions.doc:
Arbiter only, on a Disputed report; it settles BOTH reports of the dispute. `upheld`: this report
 is Verified and the one disputing it Rejected. Not upheld: the reverse. The report ruled against
 has its attestor's bond slashed to the pool's NEAR book (plan KTD9). The target stays frozen: a
 verified report stands either way, and only `lift_freeze` ends it. (Review: ruling on one report
 left the other Disputed forever, which blocked `lift_freeze` and, on a rejection, unfroze a
 target whose other report was still standing.)

functions.name: vaults_by_code_hash
functions.doc:
The vaults that run `code_hash`, with the owner recorded at registration (plan R35). A view
 over `vault_list` and `vaults`: no state of its own, so it deploys in place.

 One call examines at most `MAX_VAULT_SCAN` entries of `vault_list`, starting at index `from`
 (default 0), so its gas does not grow with the registry. `limit` lowers that bound. When
 entries remain, `next` is the index to pass as `from`; follow it until it is `None` to see
 every match exactly once. An unknown hash gives an empty page, never an error.

bond.description: Locked bond, in yoctoNEAR. Zero after a slash: such an attestor cannot report.

signing_key.description: ed25519 key that signs drift reports.

evidence_hash.description: Hash of the classifier's evidence JSON, so anyone can check a record against a re-run.

frozen.description: Set when a drift report is accepted; cleared if the arbiter rejects it.

resolved_code_hash.description: The code the target executes, from the classifier's evidence. Concentration limits use it (plan KTD7). None on records written without it: such a target cannot be covered.

upgrade_authority.description: Who can change the code: the global contract owner for `global_by_account`, else the target.

CodeRef.description: What runs on the account, as the classifier reads it. For `GlobalAccount` the ref names only the owner, which is why a report must also carry both resolved hashes.

ReportState.description: Lifecycle of an accepted report (plan, High-Level Technical Design).

RiskClass.description: The four classes of docs/CLASSIFIER.md, ordered from least to most risky, so that `class <= policy.max_risk_class` is the policy check.

state.description: Pending, Disputed, or a ruling; `get_report` turns a Pending report whose window has closed into Verified without a transaction.
